data.description: 老旧公寓高层露台窗台，远处夜空中依稀绽放着夏日祭典的绚烂花火。侧坐在窗台上，单手拉着脖颈上的黑项圈，紫黑短发随风轻拂，咬着下唇露出顽皮而危险的笑容，眼神勾魂摄魄。 她微微抬眸轻语——“电次君……真的要逃跑吗？乡村的老鼠和城市的老鼠……今晚，你只想落入哪一只的陷阱里呢？”
promptTokens: summer festival fireworks exploding in sky
data.promptProse: Reze perches on the open window sill of a run-down apartment as vibrant summer festival fireworks light up the night sky behind her, wearing a soft, bittersweet smile.
data.animaCaption: Perched on a window sill as festival fireworks burst across the night sky, sharing a tender, bittersweet smile.
